sin.name: poll-in-a-window-that-follows-events
sin.description: A window follows events and also reads on a clock, so what an event announces is read again every few seconds.
sin.rule: Read the row again when its event arrives and draw the figures the journal wrote on the row; keep usePoll only for what no event announces. PaneStage reads the usage files of the agent programs on a clock because no event announces them. OutputDock reads a running command's output lines on a clock because no event announces a new line.
